services.desc: When most people think of Orlando for spring break, they picture theme parks, crowded beaches, and late nights. But for anglers, Central Florida offers something far better: some of the most consistent and exciting spring bass fishing in the country. While tourists line up for roller coasters, you can be fighting double-digit largemouths before lunch. Spring break aligns almost exclusively perfectly with Florida’s bass spawn. From February through April, water temps stabilize in the high 50’s and 60’s. Our bass are moving up shallow to feed and bed.
